title: Ezhub
features:
Custom draggable GUI with tabs

•  Toggle switches, sliders, dropdowns, and buttons with animations  

•  Auto Fishing via Fishing GUI detection  

•  Insta Fish   

•  Insta Fish 2

•  Island selection for farming spots  

•  Teleport to selected farming island  

•  Auto Sell All with configurable sell timer  

•  Fishing Radar toggle  

•  Diving Gear 

•  Rod shop: select rod and auto-purchase 

•  Bait shop: select bait and auto-purchase  

•  Boat shop: select boat and auto-purchase

•  Teleport to any predefined island  

•  Teleport to admin event locations (Meteor Shower, Black Hole, Ghost Worm, Shocked)
